observations: Black electronic keyboard wrapped in clear plastic film.
Brand 'YAMAHA' is printed on the center of the control panel.
Model 'PSR-E333' is printed on the top right of the control panel in photo 0.
Photos contain a watermark for 'EXVO PRO AUDIO VENTURE' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.
The unit appears clean under the plastic, but the wrap obscures fine surface details.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows both the brand and model number on the chassis.

risks.risk: Internal electronic failure or dead keys.
risks.proof: A video clip of the keyboard being powered on and a chromatic scale played across all keys.
A clear photo of the screen powered on showing characters.
A photo of the power supply unit (PSU) included with the sale.

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powered on and all keys being played to confirm sound and touch response.
Photo of the LCD screen while the unit is powered on.
Photo of the rear panel showing the ports and the power adapter.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified by brand and model from the photos. It can be priced at its worst-case functional state (non-working) until proof of operation is provided.
